# Command

> Command pattern over NetService remotes.

- Package: `Command` · Category: Shared utilities
- Starts at server boot: only when picked; otherwise the first time game code uses it
- Installing it also installs: nothing else (only Core)
- Check it is installed: `GaxiaServer.IsInstalled("Command")` (server) / `Gaxia.IsInstalled("Command")` (shared/client keys)

## `Gaxia.Command`

- Runs: **server and client**
- Source: `src/ReplicatedStorage/Gaxia_Packages/Shared/Command.lua`

### Functions

- `Command.Register(name: string, def: Command): ()`
  Server: register (or replace) a named command.
- `Command.Unregister(name: string): ()`
- `Command.IsRegistered(name: string): boolean`
- `Command.Send(name: string, payload: any?): ()`
  Client: send a command to the server.
